decisions.reason: After remaining on the market through 2024 with its own dedicated page, this close-to-core multi-item line likely meets minimum aspiration levels and is worth retaining.
This serum fits the firm's established natural facial-care capabilities, and its continued presence suggests no shortfall large enough to justify reallocating resources yet.
Although less prominently presented than Product A, it is still a complementary core skincare item in a growing market, so management would more likely continue monitoring than drop it.

As the newest and least proven product it faces the most uncertainty, but because it is close to the existing offer and uses familiar resources the firm would likely keep it for another year unless results clearly disappoint.
